_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to account-limits.json and adjust — the real file is not
versioned because it contains email addresses (same rule as the .gitignore
Limit references per account, in NEW TOKENS (input + output + cache creation).
Anthropic does not expose the limit through any telemetry, and it varies by
plan — hence per account rather than a single number.
CALIBRATION IS AUTOMATIC NOW: collector/usage-truth.mjs runs /usage per
account every pass and writes block_5h/week here itself, applying the same
formula this used to ask you to run by hand: limit = meter_tokens /
(usage_percentage / 100), against what the meter published to Loki at that
also writes week_start_day/week_start_hour — the account's REAL weekly reset
moment, parsed from /usage's own text, which usage-meter.mjs uses instead of
the global WEEK_START_DAY/WEEK_START_HOUR guess in .env. To calibrate by
hand instead, apply the same formula and edit block_5h/week directly.
Accounts with no entry under 'accounts' fall back to the 'default' block.
'ignore': accounts that should not get a dashboard. Useful for a deactivated
or third-party account that still shows up in old Prometheus labels until
